name: Patellar Dislocation / Patellar Instability
definition: Transient or persistent displacement of the patella, usually laterally, with risk of recurrent instability and osteochondral injury.

investigations.MRI: MRI is useful for MPFL/osteochondral injury after first-time traumatic dislocation when indicated.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs include sunrise/merchant views when tolerated.

amber: Recurrent instability or major osteochondral injury may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-sandhi instability phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Transient or persistent displacement of the patella, usually laterally, with risk of recurrent instability and osteochondral injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
